title: Restore authenticated replay of the historical complex-ceiling control
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Four revision-7 task cards still invoke the frozen `complex-local-word-ceiling` verifier, which raises `KeyError: 'complex_profile'` against the selected #4470 schema. This tooling contribution restores their **historical positive control** without altering the predecessor checker, catalogue, scientific receipts or selected frontier.

The new `research/historical-complex-ceiling-replay` package authenticates the complete nine-file execution closure, including the exact selected-record blob at the original PR1240 base `e3bb23b4c6bae16ba277f9443e11257a0a37780a`. It reconciles the original source pins, runs the unchanged checker in a temporary tree and reproduces its exact result. The standing procedure now gives separate current-orientation and historical-replay steps. The retained #1094 checkpoint in today's tree is byte-distinct from the original selected record, so it is not substituted for the frozen pin.

**No new construction, scalar saving or κ improvement is claimed.** The historical ceiling is not a bound on #4470. The current selected value remains `60403/20000000`.

## Task and overlap

- Started from current main `7c472563474e60185e6ca101a17622133d047e56`; fetched main again before publication and confirmed that head.
- Assigned card: `complex-rank-shape-decoder`, priority revision 7, chooser nonce `3d916505ccc35c2632298bca8333380c`. **Scope changed** from decoder synthesis to the bounded first-step reproducibility repair; the original card and originating catalogue remain in `TASK.json` and `SOURCES.json`.
- [Canonical scoped claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/4458#discussioncomment-19152822); [prior mismatch handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19132013), credited rather than rediscovered.
- Complements #4906, which routes generic baseline commands but deliberately preserves named scientific replay commands, and #4463's current-schema orientation. #4631/#4936/#5050 cover sparse loading and workflow execution. This adds the authenticated historical execution route, without changing those shared tools.
- Entry search covered 304 open PR bodies and 4,625 Discussion records. Final refresh at 19:13–19:14 UTC on 2026-10-23 covered 306 open PR bodies and 4,638 Discussion records with complete remote pagination. Local note coverage was sparse; directly relevant packages, #4458/#1166 and targeted all-state PR searches were inspected. Arbitrary diffs, omitted unrelated notes and unpublished work were not covered. These searches are not a global novelty claim.

All eight external executable dependencies are pinned to exact Git blobs/SHA256 values at the base. The retained original selected record is separately bound to its historical Git object and checked as the ninth executable input. The package does not import pending PR code.

## Validation

At head `bbbcc8e583a2c395a8af91db90ecb29cfaca8ddf`:

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/historical-complex-ceiling-replay --check-only
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/historical-complex-ceiling-replay
python3 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/historical-complex-ceiling-replay
python3 -B scripts/export_research_package.py export --package research/historical-complex-ceiling-replay --ref HEAD --output /tmp/historical-complex-ceiling-replay.tar
python3 -B scripts/export_research_package.py check /tmp/historical-complex-ceiling-replay.tar
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --changed-since 7c472563474e60185e6ca101a17622133d047e56
```

- Metadata/source validation and both registered normal/`-O` modes passed on Windows CPython 3.12.0.
- Each mode runs the entire original scientific replay and its four original controls, plus **18 missing/corrupt-input rejection cases and three scientific-data rejection cases**. The latter exercise unchanged original guards for profile disagreement, an impossible previous endpoint and an altered result receipt after deliberately bypassing the wrapper's earlier hash gate.
- Committed-byte and export checks passed for 14 payload files. The planner inspected the sparse manifest inventory and selected **only this new package**.
- The committed export also passed both direct modes in a fresh, read-only Linux directory with Git unavailable (`PATH=/nonexistent`), CPython 3.12.3: 13.861 s normal and 12.608 s optimized. Output matched and all 15 files, including the export receipt, retained their hashes. Export SHA256: `eda19caf2353a1dd07a0ff76c502539871269eb4bc0613e66beb3d53b35d3f3f`.
- Exact historical output: `PASS_COMPLEX_LOCAL_WORD_CEILING a_ceiling 0.00169005410908900006 kappa<= 0.0016872026453254019`. The wrapper explicitly reports `context=PR1094 current_supplier_bound=false`.
- GitHub's public commit comparison confirms the original base is an ancestor of the pinned current main. The optional full local source-history audit was not run in this shallow checkout.
- `git diff --check` passed; working tree clean. No current selected cold replay, Lean, Docker, new cost-law proof, independent human review or proof-kernel acceptance is claimed. Hosted [Registered research packages CI](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/40010415202) passed at this exact head: onboarding helper tests, dependency planning, both registered replay modes and committed-input preservation. Both published checks concluded SUCCESS.

## Credit

Credit Douglas Colkitt and the original credited Claude assistance for PR1240, PR1012's coverage identity, and the #1094/#1042 construction and audit authors retained in the source packages. Credit the existing mismatch handoff, Mihir Srivastava's #4463/#4906, lee-phys's #4631, the retained #4936/#5050 contributors and Dennis's historical-check replay work. Original bytes and Apache-2.0 licensing are preserved.

Prepared by Mihir Srivastava (@mihir-s-05) with substantial **OpenAI Codex assistance** in inspection, implementation, documentation and verification; no subagents. This is author-checked tooling evidence.

## Open next questions

See [the package's bounded follow-ups](https://github.com/mihir-s-05/integer-mult-bounds/blob/bbbcc8e583a2c395a8af91db90ecb29cfaca8ddf/research/historical-complex-ceiling-replay/README.md#open-next-questions).

1. Derive and source-bind an applicable #4470 helper-inventory cost law and complete consumer invoice before screening current suppliers. This repair supplies neither.
2. Migrate the four emitted first-step commands with an exact-path dependency inventory and explicit treatment of frozen catalogue receipts. Contributors who bypass the standing procedure still encounter the legacy command; no catalogue repin is included here.
